meta.title: Panitera E2E WordPress
meta.author: panitera
meta.description: Situs WordPress sekali pakai untuk test E2E Panitera: admin + Application Password (REST API) + kategori contoh. Tanpa plugin custom (Zero-Friction Onboarding).

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
flush_rewrite_rules();
foreach (array('Teknologi', 'Gaya Hidup') as $name) {
  if (!term_exists($name, 'category')) {
    wp_insert_term($name, 'category');
  }
}
$user = get_user_by('login', 'admin');
if (!$user) {
  throw new Exception('User admin tidak ditemukan.');
}
$created = WP_Application_Passwords::create_new_application_password($user->ID, array('name' => 'panitera-e2e'));
if (is_wp_error($created)) {
  throw new Exception($created->get_error_message());
}
if (!is_dir('/e2e-state')) {
  throw new Exception('Direktori /e2e-state belum di-mount.');
}
file_put_contents('/e2e-state/credentials.json', json_encode(array('username' => 'admin', 'appPassword' => $created[0])));
